doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Moving to St. Claude and St. Bernard, then Bunkie
summary: After Decatur Street she worked a night spot with floor shows, went to Bunkie for about a year, then back to Luchenbach's.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well after you left the Cater Street where did you go?
I went to Stale Wiggling Wagon. Where is that? It's on uh St. Claude and uh St. Bernard.
Oh yeah. And what went on there? Same thing. Night spot. Night spot. Flo shows. Flo shows.
And we left with him and went to where? We went to Bunky. Bunky in Louisiana.
When I was Bunky, he left, went on the Bunky nightclub, club play time.
And my daughter said to work for him. And that's when we left here with the kid on it. I mean when he left with us. Yeah. And Paul. Yeah.

When I was Bunky, I worked at the Festelle maybe about, about a year. About a year then the thing began to get kind of slow with him. So we came back in. Thank you. So when he came back in, I went to the old, back to the old folks home. Left her for a time and went back. I left Luchin and went out in Bunky. Come back from Bunky and went back to Luchin. So I stayed in Luchin until I got sick.
Was that the club play time? Yeah. That's right. I don't know how it went. That's right. That's right. And Zimbaki. Yeah. Now, what tunes would you play for a show?
